subject: general
question: Which of the following types of piston ring is placed at the top of the piston in an IC engine?
solution:
The correct answer is __Compression ring**(Option 1)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Compression ring__ is placed at the top of the piston in an IC engine.
 
• The primary purpose of the compression ring is to seal the combustion chamber.
 
• This ensures that no gases escape during the power stroke of the engine.
 
• The compression ring also transfers heat from the piston to the cylinder wall.
 
• It is typically made of high-strength materials to withstand extreme conditions.
 
• A properly functioning compression ring is critical for optimal engine performance.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Pressure Ring:**

 
 
• The pressure ring is used in some engines for additional sealing purposes.
 
• It helps to distribute the pressure evenly within the cylinder.
 
 
 
• **Wiper Ring:**
 
 
• The wiper ring is located below the compression ring.
 
• It prevents oil from entering the combustion chamber.
 
 
 
• **Oil Ring:**
 
 
• The oil ring is positioned at the lower part of the piston.
 
• Its role is to control lubrication and remove excess oil from the cylinder walls.
